text.en: Pet owners appreciate the friendly welcome and professional guidance provided by Dr Kevin, Danielle, and the clinic team. Reviewers highlight that veterinarians take time to explain treatment plans without pushing unnecessary purchases. While one client reported an unhelpful experience regarding medication supply, most describe supportive and attentive care.

Clients express satisfaction with the clinical outcomes of routine health checks, diagnostic consultations, and vaccination booster appointments. Reviewers note that treatment recommendations are well considered and tailored to elderly dogs and cats. Aside from one client who wanted a written diagnosis report, owners express confidence in the veterinary care.

title.en: Caring attention for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers note that both dogs and cats are treated with genuine affection and patience during consultations. Owners of senior pets and young kittens praise the calm and reassuring handling, which helps animals settle comfortably during appointments. Clients feel confident that their pets are looked after with thoughtful care by the practice staff.

q.en: Does Medivet Hyde Park offer feline-friendly veterinary facilities?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention thoughtful and calm consultations for cats and kittens in a dedicated cat-friendly setting.

q.en: Can veterinary prescriptions and booster vaccines be managed here?

a.en: Yes, the clinic provides routine health assessments, vaccinations, booster injections, and ongoing medical prescriptions.
Emergency cases outside standard clinic opening hours are redirected to Medivet 24 Hour Kensington for continuous care.
